main_body: Flat-roofed desert building: a sand-coloured terrace roof with a teal dome on top, over a brick front wall with an arched door and a latticed window
top_band: Light sand roof surface (#e3b77e with #f2d3a0 speckle), rows 3-33 at x=32, with an inner parapet line and a dome standing on it
evidence: The column at x=32 runs from the light roof top (rows 3-33) to a lighter front-edge row at 32-33. A dark eave shadow follows at rows 34-36 (L 108 then 78), then the brick front face from rows 37-65. The roof is a large flat terrace seen from above, with a parapet and a dome, so the horizontal surface is clearly visible. The brick front has its own mortar shading, and the door and window have light frames and dark insets. The roof is tall for foreshortening, but it reads as a roof surface and not as a face, so both a top and a front are drawn.

style.evidence: Outlines are tinted dark brown and 0% of the dark edge pixels are neutral. The sand roof has speckle, the bricks are shaded in 3-4 browns with mortar lines, and the dome has 4-5 teals. Flat-fill coverage is 1%. The median of 8 colours per tile sits between the references (11 and 18). The total of 30 colours is lower than both references (66 and 185), and the door and window are simple. Overall it is slightly thinner than the references but acceptable beside them.
